answer: The quartz counter is kept in pearl and lantern shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 33 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An attacker therefore has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 33 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. Each duplicate costs another 148 dollars in locked collateral and another 9 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
